title: M4.1: Teams verification spike and decisions
description:
Verify and record the current Microsoft rules for registering a new bot (single versus multi-tenant, Azure Bot resource, Entra app, any SDK change), JWT validation requirements, activity and proactive messaging model, channel mention rule, tenant admin consent flow, and storage of conversation references. Output: comment with decisions and corrections to contract section 10.4. Registration happens in Azure (outside AWS) by the owner.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decisions recorded; owner steps listed and short
- Go or no-go for the Teams adapter stated

Gherkin: none (infrastructure or owner task); infra tests or a runbook are the evidence.

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).
